concept.title: Ask Red Hat
concept.shortdesc: Ask Red Hat is a conversational AI search tool built on Red Hat open-source AI technologies. It has access to a range of Red Hat content including product documentation, the Red Hat Knowledgebase, and product security content such as CVEs and advisories. Use it to perform the following tasks:

ul.li: Search for quick answers about Red Hat products, including error messages, security vulnerabilities, and general usage.
Access the Red Hat Knowledgebase, documentation, and other resources to find solutions to issues related to Red Hat products.

link.linktext: Ask Red Hat, Red Hat’s Conversational Search experience
